Subject: Annual prepay — confirmation on phasing, VAT and withholding

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to move forward with the annual prepay commitment (EUR 540k for FY27) but have a couple of operational asks before legal signs:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue invoices gross (with VAT) or net and rely on reverse-charge?
- Our treasury needs a clear monthly drawdown schedule (we rather sweep monthly than set up an escrow). Can you propose an exact invoice cadence and dates?
- For a few of our EU entities we might need a 5% holdback pending final delivery milestones — is that something Redwood can show on the invoice or handle as contract offset?

Attached: SOW and the broad commitment summary.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so AP can prepare the PO and cash plan.

Best,
Anna

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — confirmation on phasing, VAT and withholding

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and a proposal attached.

1) VAT / invoicing: For EU customers we typically issue invoices net and expect reverse-charge when the customer provides a valid VAT ID and certificate. If Stellar prefers gross invoices (you bear VAT), we can do that but it will increase the upfront cash.

2) Sweep cadence: Proposed approach (flexible):
   - Monthly sweep on the 1st of each month (first draw: 2026-10-01) against a prepaid credit ledger.
   - Redwood issues a consolidated invoice on the 25th of each month covering prior-period consumption and the scheduled prepay amortization slice.
   - Drawdown reporting (CSV) delivered weekly to your AP mailbox.

3) 5% holdback: We can represent a holdback line on invoices ("contractual holdback — 5% withheld until milestone sign-off") but Redwood prefers to keep settlement simple: either (A) we net the holdback against future draws or (B) we route the holdback to a separate escrow account. Option A is operationally simpler.

I attached a worksheet with dates/currency rows. Markus and Olga — tagging you for VAT & commercial confirmation.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

On Wed, 16 Sep 2026 at 08:47, soojin_lee@redwood.ai wrote:
> I attached a worksheet with dates/currency rows. Markus and Olga — tagging you for VAT & commercial confirmation.

Hi all — quick finance take:

- Treating this as an "advance" / prepayment is fine. We will issue a monthly invoice that shows the amortization slice and a separate line for the original prepay balance. If Stellar provides a valid EU VAT ID, we will include the VAT ID on our invoice and mark the supply as subject to reverse-charge (i.e., no VAT charged by Redwood).

- Holdback: Option A (netting holdback against future draws) is preferred — it avoids an escrow and reduces bank fees. On our side we'll include a dedicated code in the ledger so the drawdown tracker shows "holdback reserve" and it will be automatically released on milestone sign-off.

- Currency: Since the commitment is in EUR, invoicing and ledger will be EUR; we will include an FX note if your remit account is non-EUR.

Olga — please call out any legal/regulatory constraints (e.g., country-specific withholding).

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Anna Larsen <anna.larsen@stellarbios.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:02:00 +0300
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — confirmation on phasing, VAT and withholding

Anna / Soojin —

Legal note: reverse-charge is fine provided Stellar's entity issues the VAT ID at contract signature and the invoice references the applicable EU reverse-charge article. For the 5% holdback, contract language should specify clear milestone acceptance criteria and a release window (we usually suggest 30 days after milestone sign-off). If Stellar insists on statutory withholding in a specific jurisdiction, we will need a remittance certificate to reconcile local tax reporting.

I'll prepare a one-paragraph amendment to the SOW that captures the holdback mechanics (netting vs escrow) and milestone triggers.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi team — AP at Stellar asked us to confirm remit details and invoice expectations. A few practical points from PayGate: 

- Please include Redwood's EUR bank coordinates (IBAN) and Swift on the face of the invoice.
- If the invoice is net / reverse-charge, include Redwood VAT ID and a line: "Reverse-charge — EU VAT to be accounted for by the recipient."
- For the 5% holdback: if you opt to net it, please include a separate invoice line showing the holdback amount and a reference code so AP can tag it.
- For reconciliation, we need sample XML invoice (UBL/PEPPOL style) to map to our AP system.

Attached sample XML. Also, for multi-entity remits, indicate the billing party on each invoice (Redwood Ltd vs Redwood EU S.à r.l.).

Thanks,

Anna / AP —

Thanks everyone — summarizing what we've agreed so we can close the loop:

1) Invoicing convention: Redwood will issue monthly invoices in EUR, net of VAT, referencing Stellar's VAT ID and the EU reverse-charge note. If AP prefers gross invoices, let us know before signature.

2) Sweep / drawdown schedule: monthly sweep on the 1st (first sweep 2026-10-01). Redwood will send a consolidated amortization invoice on the 25th of each month showing the prior month consumption and the amortization slice. Weekly CSV drawdown reports to be sent each Monday to accounts-payable@stellarbios.com.

3) Holdback handling: Stellar will apply a contractual 5% holdback. Redwood will net the holdback against future draws (no separate escrow). We will track the holdback under ledger code HB-4521 and release on milestone acceptance (30 days).

4) Remit details / format: Markus to share Redwood EUR banking coordinates and the sample XML mapping by Monday. Marta — thanks for the XML sample; we'll align our invoice export to that schema.

Action items: 
- Markus: upload bank coordinates + sample XML to the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/4521) — due 2026-10-05.
- Anna/AP: confirm if you want gross VAT invoices instead of reverse-charge — reply by 2026-10-07 or we'll proceed with reverse-charge.
- Olga: small SOW amendment for holdback wording — ETA 2026-10-01.

I'll prep the DocuSign for signature once we have bank details. DocuSign link will be sent to Anna and AP.

Best,
